source_of_truth: Read by hand: the admin page's only cross-module access is `await import(`~/features/metrics/${which}`)`, a dynamic import whose specifier is a template literal computed from a runtime value. Statically it could resolve to metrics/index (fine) or metrics/internal/secret (a boundary break) depending on Math.random at runtime. No static analysis can decide which. The honest result is abstention: a correct auditor reports no boundary defect here and does not invent one. (It may legitimately note the unresolved dynamic import at info level, which is not a defect-level finding.)

forbidden.why_not_a_defect: the specifier is non-literal; the tool cannot know it reaches metrics/internal/secret, so reporting a boundary break would be an invented finding on unknowable evidence
